plan.method: Twelve balanced Williams blocks; a/b share one actual binary file per implementation; fixed original CPU.
plan.limitations: Separate focused confirmation; never pooled with the original blocks. Cannot replace the 112-label gate or establish layout, alias-path or lock-state causality. A/A ratios are descriptive controls and are never subtracted. Eleven repetitions are not eleven independent process blocks.

session.limits: Discrete outer-process samples, not continuous proof. No cross-clock timestamp alignment. Comparisons are conditional on the observed session state, not a lock/unlock causal comparison.
